title: Implement a cron next-run calculator (hard on purpose: tests decide)
prompt: Implement `nextRun(expr, after)` in src/cron.js. `expr` is a standard 5-field cron expression (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week) supporting `*`, lists (`1,15`), ranges (`1-5`) and steps (`*/15`, `10-20/5`); day-of-week is 0-6 with 0 and 7 both meaning Sunday. `after` is a Date; return the first matching Date strictly after it, in UTC, with seconds and milliseconds zero. When both day-of-month and day-of-week are restricted (neither is `*`), a day matches if either matches. Return null if nothing matches within 8 years. Throw a SyntaxError for an invalid expression (wrong field count, out of range, bad step). The tests are in test/cron.test.js; do not change them.
